title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: We trained a large deep convolutional neural network to classify 1.2 million high-resolution images in the ImageNet LSVRC-2010 contest into 1000 different classes.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract: We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks substantially deeper than those used previously.

title: You Only Look Once: Unified Real-Time Object Detection
abstract: We present YOLO a new approach to object detection. A single neural network predicts bounding boxes and class probabilities directly from full images in one evaluation.

title: Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation
abstract: We adapt contemporary classification networks into fully convolutional networks and transfer their learned representations to the segmentation task.

title: Unsupervised Representation Learning with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: We introduce a class of CNNs called deep convolutional generative adversarial networks whose architecture is a stable version of GAN.

title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
authors: Ben Mildenhall;Pratul P. Srinivasan;Matthew Tancik;Jonathan T. Barron;Ravi Ramamoorthi;Ren Ng
abstract: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing a continuous 5D neural radiance field.

title: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection
authors: Tsung-Yi Lin;Priya Goyal;Ross Girshick;Kaiming He;Piotr Dollár
abstract: We propose a focal loss that addresses the class imbalance problem during training of dense object detectors.

title: Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks
authors: Phillip Isola;Jun-Yan Zhu;Tinghui Zhou;Alexei A. Efros
abstract: We investigate conditional adversarial networks as a general-purpose solution to image-to-image translation problems.
